title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Hadhrat I got interest money from my saving account around 56000=00. I told this to my friend who keeps doing deen work 2662 views Q. I hope this email reaches you whilst you are in the best of Imaan and health. We run a small charity in the UK. I would like to know a few things regarding interest money. 1. We have a business account in the name of the charity which we use for incoming donations. I would like to know whether it is permissible to open a savings account with the sole intention of generating more interest money. 2. As we have a business account, the bank charges the charity for its services. I would like to know whether it is permissible for us to use interest money which we receive from the bank or interest money which we receive in donations to pay off these bank charges. 3. Is it permissible to use donation interest money to pay off the following, Charity car/van insurance, Business insurance, PAYE Employers tax, Please kindly respond and provide me with the answers to the following questions. May Allah accept your efforts and grant you the best of rewards for your work in this world and in the hereafter. 1440 views Q. My name is Ajaz Ahmed and I am from Kashmir. I want to set up Islamic loan facility for Muslim brothers 2031 views Q. Utilization of interest money to pay fees/Taxes imposed by Saudi Government on expatriates 3106 views Q. My question is about "Purchasing House by taking loan from Bank(definitely with interest)in overseas" --Is it lawful/unlawful. Please provide me an answer with detail documents as this would be used as Reference. 2149 views Q. Interest received from a non Islamic bank into my account 2309 views Q. Interest Received from Banks 3874 views Q. Construction Masjid Toilet 2080 views Q. Is it permissible to accept the money from the insurance company due to an accident? 2853 views Q. help by Interest amount to relative 3391 views Q. I have a business of handicraft manufacturing in delhi. Every year i have to pay a huge amount of money as income tex. My C.A. Suggested me to take L.I.C. Policy bcouse by having so i could get a benefit of 20% discount in income tex money. Could i take the policy to save 20% money? 2177 views Q. I have a query. Please clarify. Alhamdulillah i am a software engineer. Last year for saving Income-tax i had done Fixed-deposit in bank with a clear intention that i would not consume the interest money. But since even after this i had to pay income-tax (Rs.9000/- apprx.) as my salary package is masha-Allah good. I wish to know that out of the interest money earned on the Fixed-deposit [when it matures in future] can i consume Rs.9000, since i had paid that as tax. Please reply. 2128 views Q. I need clarification on medi claim policy which has prevailed in many companies which offers their employees to contribute a fixed amount every month. One part of the amount is contributed by the employer also. The benefit of the policy is the employee can claim the amount which has been expended during his/her medical treatment on condition if the treatment is under gone the listed hospitals by the medi claim service provider. 2226 views Q. मुझु L.I.C. के बारे में पूछना है, क्या insurance करवाना ठीक है? 5360 views Q. One of my uncle has invested some money in shares of a bank several years back and the share prices have appreciated quite a bit.Is it right for him to stay invested in that sector when we know that the banking industry survives on their core business i.e recieving interest on amount disbursed as loan to its customers which is not legal according to Shariat? Plz suggest a solution what should he do now if it is not right. 1841 views
answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 6642 Country: India Title: I Know very clearly that intrest is haram,but what you suggest for saving income tax, can i take medical police, home loan ( if no one give as you say that first bank should buy and then sale it to us ).i live on rent. Medical card which provided by our company free of cost is it ok to take benefits of this medical card. Question: As-salamu-alaikum I Know very clearly that intrest is haram,but what you suggest for saving income tax, can i take medical police, home loan ( if no one give as you say that first bank should buy and then sale it to us ).i live on rent. Medical card which provided by our company free of cost is it ok to take benefits of this medical card. Answer ID: 6642 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 929/849=L/1429) How will you use the interest money to save the income tax? (2) House is among the basic necessities. So if you do not have a house and face difficulties in living in rented house, also it is impossible to buy a house as per the process mentioned in the question, then in this case, it is allowable for you to take loan from the bank only as much as you need. (3) If the medical card is given to you freely, you do not have to give money for this, then it is allowable to avail this card. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
